id: title:haacked:keep negative resource filters negative for every operator

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HogQL query support for the semver_neq operator, potentially enabling version compatibility checks in retention and cohort queries.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate the implementation of the semver_neq operator and its integration into HogQL expression parsing. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H3 show the operator being added to the negative operator complement mapping and its application in property expression conversion, while P1.F2.H1 adds a corresponding test. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and compatibility behavior are not demonstrated, and the tier assignment is conservative.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the semver-specific query handling or the full context of the semver_neq operator's behavior, so the tier cannot be assigned. The observations rely on supplied hunks, not on missing implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds semver_neq to the negative operator complement mapping, treating it as the complement of semver_eq.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support HogQL queries using semver_neq, but the actual query behavior and compatibility are not demonstrated.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function negative_operator_complement and its use in property_to_expr, replacing a direct dictionary lookup.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support HogQL queries using semver_neq, but the actual query behavior and compatibility are not demonstrated.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for semver_neq with a list, expecting an AND of individual semver_neq expressions.
